chars: When an enemy model is destroyed in the Fight phase as a result of an attack made by a model with this Relic, roll one D6; on a 4+ the model with this Relic regains up to 1 lost wound.

profiles.name: Crimson Killer
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: Gorefather
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll, and on an unmodified wound roll of 6 the target suffers 3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

profiles.name: Berserker Glaive
chars: When the bearer would lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: Infernal Power
chars: If manifested, then until the start of your next Psychic phase re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <LEGION> DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this psyker.

profiles.name: Possession
chars: If manifested, then until the start of your next Psychic phase, the Armour Penetration characteristic of the psyker's melee weapon is improved by 2 (e.g. an AP of -1 becomes -3). Furthermore, until the start of your next Psychic phase, each time the psyker destroys an enemy INFANTRY CHARACTER in the Fight phase, you can add a Chaos Spawn model to your army. If the destroyed model was ADEPTUS ASTARTES or HERETIC ASTARTES, you can instead add a Greater Possessed model to your army. If a new model is added to your army, set it up within 6" of the psyker and more than 1" from any enemy models. In addition, each time the psyker destroys an enemy VEHICLE model in the Fight phase that could explode, it automatically explodes; no dice roll is made and any mortal wounds suffered by the psyker in the resulting explosion are ignored.

profiles.name: Sacrifice
chars: If manifested, choose any model within 2" of the psyker; that model suffers a mortal wound. Then, choose a friendly <LEGION> DAEMON model within 18" of the psyker. That model regains D3 lost wounds. If that <LEGION> DAEMON model is a DAEMON ENGINE and the model you chose to inflict the mortal wound on was a friendly <LEGION> WARPSMITH, the DAEMON ENGINE regains 3 lost wounds instead.

profiles.name: Mutated Invigoration
chars: If manifested, select a friendly CHAOS SPAWN, <LEGION> POSSESSED, or <LEGION> CULT OF DESTRUCTION unit within 18" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, that unit will gain a bonus depending on what unit it is, as below: 1. You can re-roll the dice when rolling for that Chaos Spawn's Mutated Beyond Reason ability. 2. You can re-roll the dice when rolling for the Attacks characteristic of that unit of Possessed due to its Writhing Tentacles ability. 3. You can re-roll one of the dice when rolling for the Strength, AP and Damage characteristics of that Cult of Destruction unit's weapons due to its Fleshmetal Guns or Fleshmetal Weapons ability.

profiles.name: Incursion
chars: If manifested, the psyker can immediately summon attempt to summon a unit of DAEMONS to the battlefield using the Daemonic Ritual ability as if it were the Movement phase. When doing so, roll up to 4 dice instead of up to 3. The psyker will not suffer any mortal wounds as a result of doubles or triples being rolled for this Daemonic Ritual.

profiles.name: Cursed Earth
chars: If manifested, then until the start of your next Psychic phase, the invulnerable save of friendly <LEGION> DAEMON units is improved by 1 (to a maximum of 3+) whilst they are within 6" of this psyker.

profiles.name: Shepherd of the True Faith
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack made with a melee weapon by a friendly DAEMONKIN RITUALIST unit within 6" of your Warlord, that attack inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to the normal damage.

profiles.name: Chosen of the Warmaster
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units while they are witihn 6" of your Warlord. If your Warlord has the Lord of Chaos ability, you can instead re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Armour Bane
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEVASTATION BATTERY units that are within 6" of your Warlord if the target is a VEHICLE.

profiles.name: The Tip of the Claw
chars: Add 2 to charge rolls made for friendly HOST RAPTORIAL units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Master of the Soulforges
chars: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly SOULFORGED PACK DAEMON ENGINES while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Exultant Preacher
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly CULT OF THE DAMNED units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Axe of Blind Fury
chars: You cannot re-roll or modify to hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with the Axe of Blind Fury. Instead, these attacks automatically hit a friendly unit within 1". Randomly determine which unit is hit if there is more than 1. If there are no friendly units within 1", the hit is ignored.

profiles.name: Axe of Blind Fury
chars: Models with a power axe only. The Axe of Blind Fury replaces the bearer's power axe.

profiles.name: Blade of the Hydra
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make D3 additional attacks with this weapon.

profiles.name: Blade of the Hydra
chars: Models with a chainsword only. The Blade of the Hydra replaces the bearer's chainsword.

profiles.name: Blissgiver
chars: This weapon can be fired within 1" of an enemy unit, and can target enemy units within 1" of friendly units. If an enemy CHARACTER model is wounded by Blissgiver but not slain, roll a D6 at the end of the phase, on a 6, they suffer D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Blissgiver
chars: Models with a bolt pistol only. Blissgiver replaces the bearer's bolt pistol.

profiles.name: Brass Collar of Borghaster
chars: The bearer of the Brass Collar of Borghaster can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase. If this model makes a successful Deny the Witch test, the psyker that was attempting to manifest the power immediately suffers Perils of the Warp.

profiles.name: Claws of the Black Hunt
chars: Increase the wielder's Attacks characteristic by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed wound rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Claws of the Black Hunt
chars: Models with two lightning claws only. The Claws of the Black Hunt replaces both of the bearer's lightning claws.

profiles.name: Eye of Tzeentch
chars: The bearer of the Eye of Tzeentch adds 1 to their Psychic test when attempting to manifest the Smite power.

profiles.name: Fleshmetal Exoskeleton
chars: The bearer of the Fleshmetal Exoskeleton has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, this model heals 1 wound at the start of each of your turns.

profiles.name: Intoxicating Elixir
chars: Add 1 to the bearer's Strength and Attacks characteristics.

profiles.name: Puscleaver
chars: This weapon wound on a 2+, unless the target is a VEHICLE, in which case roll to wound as normal.

profiles.name: Puscleaver
chars: Models with a power sword only. Puscleaver replaces the bearer's power sword.

profiles.name: Talisman of Burning Blood
chars: The bearer of the Talisman of Burning Blood can Advance and charge in the same turn. Furthermore, the bearer can re-roll failed charge rolls.

profiles.name: The Black Mace
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model is slain by the Black Mace; on a 6, that model's unit suffers an additional mortal wound at the end of the phase.

profiles.name: The Black Mace
chars: Models with a power maul or accursed crozius only. The Black Mace replaces the bearer's power maul or accursed crozius.

profiles.name: The Cursed Crozius
chars: Re-roll all failed wound rolls for this weapon when targeting an IMPERIUM unit.

profiles.name: The Cursed Crozius
chars: Models with a power maul or accursed crozius only. The Cursed Crozius replaces the bearer's power maul or accursed crozius.

profiles.name: The Eye of Night
chars: The Bearer can unleash the power of the Eye of Night once per battle, in their Shooting phase, instead of firing any other weapons. When they do so, select a visible VEHICLE unit and roll a D6; on a 2+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: The Murder Sword
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn has begun, you must nominate one enemy CHARACTER to be the target of the bearer of the Murder Sword (this can be a character not yet set up on the battlefield). Remember to tell your opponent which character you have nominated. Each attack made with the Murder Sword that hits the selected character automatically inflicts a mortal wound upon that character instead of the normal damage.

profiles.name: The Murder Sword
chars: Models with a power sword only. The Murder sword replaces the bearer's power sword.

profiles.name: Chiropteran Wings
chars: Roll a D6 for each enemy unit that was moved across by the bearer in the Movement or Charge phase. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Foecleaver
chars: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this weapon that target IMPERIUM units.

profiles.name: Foecleaver
chars: Model with a power axe only. Foecleaver replaces the model's power axe.

profiles.name: Mecha-serpents
chars: Model with mechatendrils only. The Mecha-serpents replace the bearer’s mechatendrils and have the profile below.

profiles.name: Mecha-serpents
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 (and only 1) attack with this weapon for each enemy model within 1" of the bearer.

profiles.name: The Burning Rod
chars: Model with force stave only. The Burning Rod replaces the bearer’s force stave and has the following profile.

profiles.name: The Burning Rod
chars: At the end of each Fight phase, you can pick a unit within 1" of the bearer. That unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: The Daemon's Eye
chars: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick a friendly DEVASTATION BATTERY unit within 6" of the bearer. Enemy units do no receive the benefit of cover against that unit's weapons this phase.

profiles.name: The Inferno Tome
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target.

profiles.name: The Inferno Tome
chars: The bearer is armed with a ranged weapon with the profile below in addition to any other ranged weapons it is armed with.

profiles.name: Blade of the Relentless
chars: CRIMSON SLAUGHTER model with a power sword only. The Blade of the Relentless replaces the model's power sword.

profiles.name: Blade of the Relentless
chars: If the bearer slays any enemy models in the Fight phase with this weapon, then from the end of that Fight phase until the end of the battle, wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon are automatically successful (no wound roll is made).

profiles.name: Book of Untruth
chars: SCOURGED model only. Each time an enemy PSYKER within 18" of the bearer successfully manifests a psychic power, roll a D6. On a 5+, that psyker suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: Daemonflesh Plate
chars: BRAZEN BEASTS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, add 1 to the bearer's Move and Attacks characteristics.

profiles.name: Flawless Cloak
chars: Add 1 to the bearer's Attacks characteristic. In addition, increase the range of the bearer's aura abilities (e.g. Lord of Chaos, Demagogue, etc.) by 3".

profiles.name: Maelstrom's Bite
chars: RED CORSAIRS model with combi-melta only. Maelstrom's Bite replaces the model's combi-melta.

profiles.name: Maelstrom's Bite - Meltagun
chars: If the target is within half range of this weapon, roll two dice when inflicting damage with it and discard the lowest result.

profiles.name: Maelstrom's Bite
chars: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles below. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls made for this weapon.

profiles.name: Orb of Unlife
chars: PURGE model only. Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, the bearer can throw the Orb of Unlife instead of firing any ranged weapons. If they do so, pick a point on the battlefield within 8" of the bearer. Roll a D6 for each unit within D6" of that point, subtracting 2 from the result if the unit is a VEHICLE. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Angelsbane
chars: This weapon has a Damage characteristic of 3 if the target has the IMPERIUM keyword.

profiles.name: Angelsbane
chars: Models with a combi-bolter only. Angelsbane replaces the bearer's combi-bolter.

profiles.name: Ghorisvex's Teeth
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 2 additional attacks with this weapon. Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made with this weapon, the target of the attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to the normal damage.

profiles.name: Ghorisvex's Teeth
chars: Model with chainsword only. Ghorisvex’s Teeth replaces the bearer’s chainsword and has the profile below.

profiles.name: Trophies of Slaughter
chars: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly BLACK LEGION units while they are within 6" of the bearer. In addition, subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of the bearer.

profiles.name: Sightless Helm
chars: Worsen the bearer’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 2+ becomes BS 3+), but improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of all of the bearer’s weapons by 1 (e.g. AP 0 becomes AP -1).

profiles.name: Cloak of Conquest
chars: Each time the bearer slays an enemy CHARACTER, add 1 to the bearer’s Strength, Attacks and Leadership characteristics until the end of the battle.

profiles.name: Spineshiver Blade
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make D6 additional attacks with this weapon.

profiles.name: Spineshiver Blade
chars: Model with power sword only. The Spineshiver Blade replaces the bearer’s power sword and has the profile below.

profiles.name: Smite
chars: If manifested, the closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers 1 mortal wound. If the result of the Psychic test was more than 10 the target suffers D3 mortal wounds instead.

profiles.name: Lord of Chaos
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly BLACK LEGION and friendly SERVANTS OF THE ABYSS units within 6" of Obsidius Mallex.

profiles.name: Sigil of Corruption
chars: Obsidius Mallex has a 4+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: Death to the False Emperor
chars: Each time you roll a hit roll of 6+ for a model with this ability in the Fight phase, it can, if it was targeting an IMPERIUM unit, immediately make an extra attack against the same unit using the same weapon. These extra attacks cannot themselves generate any further attacks.

profiles.name: Thunder hammer
chars: When attacking with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Eternal Vendetta
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by your Warlord in the Fight phase against targets with the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword.

profiles.name: Flames of Spite
chars: If the wound roll for a melee weapon attack made by your Warlord is 6+, it inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any other damage.

profiles.name: Unholy Fortitude
chars: Add 1 to the Wounds characteristic of your Warlord. In addition, roll a dice each time yourWarlord loses a wound. On a roll of 6, your warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Hatred Incarnate
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Warlord.

profiles.name: Lord of Terror
chars: The opposing player must roll an extra dice when taking Morale tests for units within 6" of your Warlord, and use the highest result.

profiles.name: Exalted Champion
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Master of Timing
chars: You can re-roll one failed Reserve roll each turn.

profiles.name: Burner of Worlds
chars: When you make Firestorm attacks, add 1 to the total number you can make.

profiles.name: Planetary Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Lord of Ambush
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord if targeting an Attacking unit that arrived as reinforcements this turn.

profiles.name: Planetary Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Counterfire Master
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord (this includes any BUILDING they are embarked within, and any other units embarked within the same building).

profiles.name: Fortress Commander
chars: If your Warlord is embarked within a BUILDING, roll a dice each time that building loses a wound; on a 6+, the building does not lose a wound.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: Siege Breaker
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they declare a charge against a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Fortress Destroyer
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they target a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: 1. Cityfight Specialist
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, you receive 3 additional Command Points. These can only be spent to use Cities of Death Stratagems (pg 32-35).

profiles.name: 2. Conqueror of Worlds
chars: If this Warlord is within range of an objective marker (see above) it controls that objective marker even if there are more enemy models within range of the same objective marker. If an enemy unit within range of the same objective marker has a similar ability, then the objective marker is controlled by the player who has the most models within range of it as normal.

profiles.name: 3. Urban Warrior
chars: This Warlord treats all soft cover it is entirely on or within, or that it is receiving the benefit of cover from, as hard cover (pg 30). In addition, enemy units do not receive the benefit to their saving throws for being in cover against attacks made by this Warlord.

profiles.name: First Among Traitors
chars: The Death to the False Emperor ability triggers an extra attack on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+ for models in friendly BLACK LEGION units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Shattering Truth
chars: At the start of each Fight phase, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of your Warlord. That unit cannot be picked to fight with in the Fight phase until all other units able to fight have done so. If the target unit has an ability that allows it to fight first in the Fight phase, it insteads fights as if it didn't have that ability. If both players have units that cannot fight until all other units have done so, then alternate picking which of those units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Carve the Runes
chars: Each time your Warlord slays an enemy CHARACTER, add 2 to your Warlord's Strength and Attacks characteristics until the end of the battle.

profiles.name: Maelstrom of Torment
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy untis within 6" of your Warlord. If your Warlord has slain any enemy models, then until the end of the battle, subtract 2 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy models within 9" of your Warlord instead.

profiles.name: Blessed Mission
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Warlord. In addition, you can re-roll damage rolls for weapons used by your Warlord.

profiles.name: Ultimate Confidence
chars: If your Warlord generates extra attacks as a result of their Death to the Imperfect trait, they can immediately make 3 additional attacks, instead of only 1, against the same unit using the same weapon. These extra attacks cannot themselves generate any further attacks.

profiles.name: Reaver Lord
chars: Your army can have one extra relic, chosen from the Artefacts of Chaos, which must be given to a RED CORSAIRS CHARACTER from your army that does not already have a relic. This relic must be different to any relics already included in your army. In addition, each time your Warlord slays an enemy CHARACTER, add 1 to your Warlord's Attack characteristic until the end of the battle.

profiles.name: Arch-Sorceror
chars: Your Warlord knows 1 additional psychic power from any of the disciplines listed on their datasheet.

profiles.name: Devourer of Magic
chars: Your Warlord can attempt to deny one additional power in each enemy Psychic phase. In addition, your Warlord regains 1 lost wound each time it successfully denies a psychic power.

profiles.name: Reader of Fate
chars: Once per battle, you can re-roll a failed Psychic test or Deny the Witch test for your Warlord. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged, roll a D6 each time your Warlord successfully manifests a psychic power; on a 6 you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: Infernal Gaze
chars: If your Warlord successfully manifests the Smite psychic power, the closest visible enemy unit within 24" suffers mortal wounds, instead of 18".

profiles.name: Warp Lord
chars: You can re-roll rolls of 1 when taking a Psychic test for your Warlord.

profiles.name: Daemon-bound Power
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord's Strength characteristic. In addition, you can re-roll damage rolls made for attacks with your Warlord's force weapon. For the purposes of this Warlord Trait, a force weapon is any weapon whose name includes the word 'force' (excluding Artefacts of Chaos).

profiles.name: Shepherd of the True Faith
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack made with a melee weapon by a friendly DAEMONKIN RITUALIST unit within 6" of your Warlord, that attack inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to the normal damage.

profiles.name: Chosen of the Warmaster
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units while they are witihn 6" of your Warlord. If your Warlord has the Lord of Chaos ability, you can instead re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Armour Bane
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEVASTATION BATTERY units that are within 6" of your Warlord if the target is a VEHICLE.

profiles.name: The Tip of the Claw
chars: Add 2 to charge rolls made for friendly HOST RAPTORIAL units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Master of the Soulforges
chars: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly SOULFORGED PACK DAEMON ENGINES while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Exultant Preacher
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly CULT OF THE DAMNED units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Veteran Raider
chars: While they are within 6" of your Warlord, friendly BLACK LEGION units can declare a charge even if they Fell Back in the same turn.

profiles.name: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by your Warlord is halved, rounding up.

profiles.name: Black-clad Brute
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord’s Strength characteristic. In addition, after your Warlord makes a charge move, pick an enemy unit within 1" of your Warlord and roll a D6. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Soul-eater
chars: Each time your Warlord destroys an enemy unit, your Warlord immediately regains D3 lost wounds.

profiles.name: Trusted War-leader
chars: While your Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a D6 each time you spend a Command Point to use a Stratagem; on a 5+ that Command Point is immediately refunded.

profiles.name: First Among Traitors
chars: The Death to the False Emperor ability triggers an extra attack on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+ for models in friendly BLACK LEGION units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: The Voice of Lorgar
chars: Add 3" to the range of this Warlord’s aura abilities (e.g. Lord of Chaos).

profiles.name: Exalted Possession
chars: This Warlord gains the POSSESSED and DAEMON keywords (if they don’t already have them). Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of this Warlord, and add 1" to this Warlord’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: Daemonic Whispers
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, roll one D3 before the battle begins; you gain a number of additional Command Points equal to the result. Once per battle, if this Warlord is on the battlefield, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: Master of the Union
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in friendly WORD BEARERS DAEMON units whilst their unit is within 6" of this Warlord.

profiles.name: Diabolist
chars: When this Warlord would lose a wound, roll one D6, adding 3 to the result if that wound would be lost as the result of a mortal wound; on a 6+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: Sacrilegious Regeneration
chars: Add 1 to this Warlord’s Wounds characteristic. At the start of your turn, this Warlord regains up to D3 lost wounds.

profiles.name: Night Haunter's Curse
chars: Once per battle round, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll, damage roll, Advance roll, charge roll or saving throw made for this Warlord.

profiles.name: One Piece at a Time
chars: This Warlord can charge in a turn in which they Fell Back. When resolving an attack made with a melee weapon against this Warlord, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Murderous Reputation
chars: When resolving an attack made by this Warlord, an unmodified hit roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any other damage.

profiles.name: Killing Fury
chars: Add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of this Warlord in a turn in which they made a charge move, were charged or performed a Heroic Intervention. These additional attacks last until the end of the Fight phase.

profiles.name: One with the Shadows
chars: When resolving an attack made against this Warlord whilst they are entirely on or within a terrain feature, add 1 to the saving throw (excluding invulnerable saving throws). Whilst this Warlord is entirely on or within a terrain feature, improve its invulnerable save by 1, to a maximum of 3+ (e.g. a 4+ invulnerable save becomes 3+).

profiles.name: Dirty Fighter
chars: Whilst there are more friendly models within 3" of this Warlord than enemy models, when resolving an attack made with a melee weapon by this Warlord, add 1 to the wound roll.

profiles.name: I am Alpharius
chars:
In addition to this Warlord Trait, this Warlord has one randomly generated Chaos Space Marine Warlord Trait from Codex: Chaos Space Marines. If this Warlord is destroyed, you can immediately select another ALPHA LEGION CHARACTER model from your army to take their place and generate a Warlord Trait for them (including this one). If the mission you are playing grants victory points for destroying
the enemy Warlord, your opponent will only achieve that objective if all of the ALPHA LEGION CHARACTER models from your army have been destroyed.

profiles.name: Clandestine
chars: When resolving an attack made against this Warlord, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Headhunter
chars: This Warlord can target CHARACTER units even if they are not the closest enemy unit. When resolving an attack made with a ranged weapon by this Warlord, an unmodified hit roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any other damage.

profiles.name: Master of Diversion
chars: At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, select up to three other friendly ALPHA LEGION units on the battlefield. Remove these units from the battlefield and set them up again following the usual deployment rules for those units and the mission. If you redeploy a TRANSPORT model, all units embarked inside it remain so when it is set up again.

profiles.name: Cult Leader
chars: When resolving an attack made with a weapon by a model in a friendly ALPHA LEGION CHAOS CULTIST unit within 6" of this Warlord, on an unmodified wound roll of 6 the Armour Penetration characteristic of that weapon is improved by 1 for that attack (e.g. AP 0 becomes AP -1).

profiles.name: Faceless Commander
chars: Once per battle, at the end of your Movement phase, you can remove this Warlord from the battlefield and set them up again within 3" of a friendly ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY unit and more than 9" away from enemy models.

profiles.name: Cold and Bitter
chars: When a Morale test is taken for a friendly IRON WARRIORS unit within 6" of this Warlord, do not roll the dice; it is automatically passed.

profiles.name: Daemonsmith
chars: When resolving an attack made by a model in a friendly IRON WARRIORS DAEMON ENGINE or IRON WARRIORS CULT OF DESTRUCTION unit within 6" of this Warlord, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

profiles.name: Iron Without
chars: When this Warlord would lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: Bastion
chars: When resolving an attack made with a weapon that has an Armour Penetration characteristic of -1 against a friendly IRON WARRIORS unit that is within 6" of this Warlord and receiving the benefit of cover, that weapon is treated as having an Armour Penetration characteristic of 0.

profiles.name: Siege Master
chars: When resolving an attack made with a ranged weapon by a model in a friendly IRON WARRIORS HAVOCS or IRON WARRIORS VEHICLE unit within 6" of this Warlord, re-roll a wound roll of 1.

profiles.name: Stoic Advance
chars: Friendly IRON WARRIORS units do not suffer the penalty for moving and firing Heavy weapons whilst they are within 6" of this Warlord.

profiles.name: Stimulated By Pain
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord’s Attacks characteristic for each wound he has suffered (to a maximum of +3). If your Warlord regains any lost wounds, he loses the associated bonus attacks.

profiles.name: Intoxicating Musk
chars: When resolving an attack made by an enemy unit within 3" of this Warlord, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Unbound Arrogance
chars: When you choose this Warlord to fight with, you and your opponent secretly choose a number from 1 to 3 on a D6 (we suggest turning a D6 to show the number but concealing this behind your hand), then reveal your choice simultaneously. If the chosen numbers differ, this Warlord can make a number of additional attacks that fight sequence equal to the number you chose.

profiles.name: Faultless Duellist
chars: At the start of the Fight phase, roll one D3. Until the end of that phase, subtract the result from the Attacks characteristic of enemy models (to a minimum of 1) whilst they are within 1" of this Warlord.

profiles.name: Glutton for Punishment
chars: When resolving an attack against this Warlord, reduce any damage inflicted by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

profiles.name: Loathsome Grace
chars: When a charge roll is made for this Warlord, you can re-roll the dice. If this Warlord makes a charge move or performs a Heroic Intervention, add 1 to their Strength and Attacks characteristics until the end of the subsequent Fight phase.

profiles.name: Slaughterborn
chars: When an enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER or TITANIC model is destroyed as a result of an attack made by this Warlord, add 1 to this Warlord’s Attacks and Strength characteristics.

profiles.name: Arch Slaughterer
chars: At the start of the Fight phase, add D3 to this Warlord’s Attacks characteristic if there are more enemy models within 3" of them than there are friendly models. These extra attacks last until the end of that Fight phase.

profiles.name: Disciple of Khorne
chars: When resolving an attack made with a melee weapon by this Warlord against an enemy CHARACTER unit or a unit that contains any models with a Wounds characteristic of 5 or more, you can re-roll the hit roll and you can re-roll the wound roll.

profiles.name: Violent Urgency
chars: When an Advance or charge roll is made for a friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 6" of this Warlord, add 1 to the result.

profiles.name: True Berserker
chars: When resolving an attack made with a melee weapon against this model, halve any damage inflicted (rounding up).

profiles.name: Battle-lust
chars: This Warlord can perform a Heroic Intervention if there are any enemy units within 6" of them instead of 3", and when doing so can move up to 6" instead of 3". This Warlord always fights first in the Fight phase even if they didn’t charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, then alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Sorcerer
chars: Smite and 2 powers from the Dark Hereticus discipline

profiles.name: Death to the False Emperor
chars: Each time you roll a hit roll of 6+ for a model with this ability in the Fight phase, it can, if it was targeting an IMPERIUM unit, immediately make an extra attack against the same unit using the same weapon. These extra attacks cannot themselves generate any further attacks.

profiles.name: Plasma pistol, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain.

profiles.name: Flamer
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target.

rules.name: Combi Weapon
rules.text: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Meltagun
chars: When resolving an attack with this weapon against a target that is within half range, roll two D6 when inflicting damage with it and discard one of the results.

rules.name: Combi Weapon
rules.text: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Plasma gun, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

rules.name: Combi Weapon
rules.text: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Chainsword
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Lightning claw
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for this weapon. If a model is armed with two lightning claws, each time it fights it can make 1 additional attack with them.

profiles.name: Power fist
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you must subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Thunder hammer
chars: When attacking with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Smite
chars: If manifested, the closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers 1 mortal wound. If the result of the Psychic test was more than 10 the target suffers D3 mortal wounds instead.

profiles.name: Infernal Gaze
chars: If manifested, select a visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker and roll 3 dice. The target suffers one mortal wound for each roll of 4+.

profiles.name: Warptime
chars: If manifested, pick a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 3" of the psyker. That unit can immediately move as if it were its Movement phase. You cannot use Warptime on a unit more than once in each Psychic phase.

profiles.name: Prescience
chars: If manifested, select a HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 18" of the psyker. You can add 1 to all hit rolls made for that unit until the start of your next Psychic phase.

profiles.name: Weaver of Fates
chars: If manifested, select a visible TZEENTCH HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 18" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, the invulnerable save of that unit is improved by 1 (to a maximum of 3+). Models that do not have an invulnerable save instead gain a 5+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: Gift of Chaos
chars: If manifested, select an enemy unit that is within 6" of the psyker and visible to him and roll a D6. If the result is greater than the enemy's Toughness, it suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. If a Character is slain by this power, you can add a Chaos Spawn to your army within 6" of the character and more than 1" from any enemy models before they are removed as a casualty.

profiles.name: Diabolic Strength
chars: If manifested, select a HERETIC ASTARTES model within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, add 2 to the model's Strength characteristic and 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Death Hex
chars: If manifested, select a visible enemy unit within 12" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, that unit cannot take invulnerable saves.

profiles.name: Miasma of Pestilence
chars: If manifested, select a visible NURGLE HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 18" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls that target that unit.

profiles.name: Delightful Agonies
chars: If manifested, select a visible SLAANESH HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 18" of the psyker. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, roll a D6 each time that unit suffers a wound; on a 5+, it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: Axe of Blind Fury
chars: You cannot re-roll or modify to hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with the Axe of Blind Fury. Instead, these attacks automatically hit a friendly unit within 1". Randomly determine which unit is hit if there is more than 1. If there are no friendly units within 1", the hit is ignored.

profiles.name: Axe of Blind Fury
chars: Models with a power axe only. The Axe of Blind Fury replaces the bearer's power axe.

profiles.name: Blade of the Hydra
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make D3 additional attacks with this weapon.

profiles.name: Blade of the Hydra
chars: Models with a chainsword only. The Blade of the Hydra replaces the bearer's chainsword.

profiles.name: Blissgiver
chars: This weapon can be fired within 1" of an enemy unit, and can target enemy units within 1" of friendly units. If an enemy CHARACTER model is wounded by Blissgiver but not slain, roll a D6 at the end of the phase, on a 6, they suffer D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Blissgiver
chars: Models with a bolt pistol only. Blissgiver replaces the bearer's bolt pistol.

profiles.name: Brass Collar of Borghaster
chars: The bearer of the Brass Collar of Borghaster can attempt to deny one psychic power in each enemy Psychic phase. If this model makes a successful Deny the Witch test, the psyker that was attempting to manifest the power immediately suffers Perils of the Warp.

profiles.name: Claws of the Black Hunt
chars: Increase the wielder's Attacks characteristic by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed wound rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Claws of the Black Hunt
chars: Models with two lightning claws only. The Claws of the Black Hunt replaces both of the bearer's lightning claws.

profiles.name: Eye of Tzeentch
chars: The bearer of the Eye of Tzeentch adds 1 to their Psychic test when attempting to manifest the Smite power.

profiles.name: Fleshmetal Exoskeleton
chars: The bearer of the Fleshmetal Exoskeleton has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, this model heals 1 wound at the start of each of your turns.

profiles.name: Intoxicating Elixir
chars: Add 1 to the bearer's Strength and Attacks characteristics.

profiles.name: Puscleaver
chars: This weapon wound on a 2+, unless the target is a VEHICLE, in which case roll to wound as normal.

profiles.name: Puscleaver
chars: Models with a power sword only. Puscleaver replaces the bearer's power sword.

profiles.name: Talisman of Burning Blood
chars: The bearer of the Talisman of Burning Blood can Advance and charge in the same turn. Furthermore, the bearer can re-roll failed charge rolls.

profiles.name: The Black Mace
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model is slain by the Black Mace; on a 6, that model's unit suffers an additional mortal wound at the end of the phase.

profiles.name: The Black Mace
chars: Models with a power maul or accursed crozius only. The Black Mace replaces the bearer's power maul or accursed crozius.

profiles.name: The Cursed Crozius
chars: Re-roll all failed wound rolls for this weapon when targeting an IMPERIUM unit.

profiles.name: The Cursed Crozius
chars: Models with a power maul or accursed crozius only. The Cursed Crozius replaces the bearer's power maul or accursed crozius.

profiles.name: The Eye of Night
chars: The Bearer can unleash the power of the Eye of Night once per battle, in their Shooting phase, instead of firing any other weapons. When they do so, select a visible VEHICLE unit and roll a D6; on a 2+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: The Murder Sword
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn has begun, you must nominate one enemy CHARACTER to be the target of the bearer of the Murder Sword (this can be a character not yet set up on the battlefield). Remember to tell your opponent which character you have nominated. Each attack made with the Murder Sword that hits the selected character automatically inflicts a mortal wound upon that character instead of the normal damage.

profiles.name: The Murder Sword
chars: Models with a power sword only. The Murder sword replaces the bearer's power sword.

profiles.name: Chiropteran Wings
chars: Roll a D6 for each enemy unit that was moved across by the bearer in the Movement or Charge phase. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Foecleaver
chars: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this weapon that target IMPERIUM units.

profiles.name: Foecleaver
chars: Model with a power axe only. Foecleaver replaces the model's power axe.

profiles.name: Mecha-serpents
chars: Model with mechatendrils only. The Mecha-serpents replace the bearer’s mechatendrils and have the profile below.

profiles.name: Mecha-serpents
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 (and only 1) attack with this weapon for each enemy model within 1" of the bearer.

profiles.name: The Burning Rod
chars: Model with force stave only. The Burning Rod replaces the bearer’s force stave and has the following profile.

profiles.name: The Burning Rod
chars: At the end of each Fight phase, you can pick a unit within 1" of the bearer. That unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: The Daemon's Eye
chars: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick a friendly DEVASTATION BATTERY unit within 6" of the bearer. Enemy units do no receive the benefit of cover against that unit's weapons this phase.

profiles.name: The Inferno Tome
chars: This weapon automatically hits its target.

profiles.name: The Inferno Tome
chars: The bearer is armed with a ranged weapon with the profile below in addition to any other ranged weapons it is armed with.

profiles.name: Blade of the Relentless
chars: CRIMSON SLAUGHTER model with a power sword only. The Blade of the Relentless replaces the model's power sword.

profiles.name: Blade of the Relentless
chars: If the bearer slays any enemy models in the Fight phase with this weapon, then from the end of that Fight phase until the end of the battle, wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon are automatically successful (no wound roll is made).

profiles.name: Book of Untruth
chars: SCOURGED model only. Each time an enemy PSYKER within 18" of the bearer successfully manifests a psychic power, roll a D6. On a 5+, that psyker suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: Daemonflesh Plate
chars: BRAZEN BEASTS model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, add 1 to the bearer's Move and Attacks characteristics.

profiles.name: Flawless Cloak
chars: Add 1 to the bearer's Attacks characteristic. In addition, increase the range of the bearer's aura abilities (e.g. Lord of Chaos, Demagogue, etc.) by 3".

profiles.name: Maelstrom's Bite
chars: RED CORSAIRS model with combi-melta only. Maelstrom's Bite replaces the model's combi-melta.

profiles.name: Maelstrom's Bite - Meltagun
chars: If the target is within half range of this weapon, roll two dice when inflicting damage with it and discard the lowest result.

profiles.name: Maelstrom's Bite
chars: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles below. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls made for this weapon.

profiles.name: Orb of Unlife
chars: PURGE model only. Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, the bearer can throw the Orb of Unlife instead of firing any ranged weapons. If they do so, pick a point on the battlefield within 8" of the bearer. Roll a D6 for each unit within D6" of that point, subtracting 2 from the result if the unit is a VEHICLE. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Angelsbane
chars: This weapon has a Damage characteristic of 3 if the target has the IMPERIUM keyword.

profiles.name: Angelsbane
chars: Models with a combi-bolter only. Angelsbane replaces the bearer's combi-bolter.

profiles.name: Ghorisvex's Teeth
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 2 additional attacks with this weapon. Each time you roll a wound roll of 6+ for an attack made with this weapon, the target of the attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to the normal damage.

profiles.name: Ghorisvex's Teeth
chars: Model with chainsword only. Ghorisvex’s Teeth replaces the bearer’s chainsword and has the profile below.

profiles.name: Trophies of Slaughter
chars: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly BLACK LEGION units while they are within 6" of the bearer. In addition, subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of the bearer.

profiles.name: Sightless Helm
chars: Worsen the bearer’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 2+ becomes BS 3+), but improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of all of the bearer’s weapons by 1 (e.g. AP 0 becomes AP -1).

profiles.name: Cloak of Conquest
chars: Each time the bearer slays an enemy CHARACTER, add 1 to the bearer’s Strength, Attacks and Leadership characteristics until the end of the battle.

profiles.name: Spineshiver Blade
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make D6 additional attacks with this weapon.

profiles.name: Spineshiver Blade
chars: Model with power sword only. The Spineshiver Blade replaces the bearer’s power sword and has the profile below.

profiles.name: Q'O'Ak the Boundless
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, invulnerable saves cannot be made.

rules.name: Daemon Weapon
rules.text: In the Fight phase, when this model is chosen to fight with for the first time that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, the model suffers 1 mortal wound and cannot use this weapon further that phase. On a 2+ the model can fight with the weapon as normal.

profiles.name: The Rapacious Talons
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, you can re-roll the wound roll. When rolling for this weapon’s Daemon Weapon ability, on a 2+ you can make a number of additional attacks equal to the result with this weapon this phase.

rules.name: Daemon Weapon
rules.text: In the Fight phase, when this model is chosen to fight with for the first time that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, the model suffers 1 mortal wound and cannot use this weapon further that phase. On a 2+ the model can fight with the weapon as normal.

profiles.name: Z'aall, The Wrathful
chars: When rolling for this weapon’s Daemon Weapon ability, on a 2+ add a number to this weapon’s Strength characteristic equal to the result until the end of this phase.

rules.name: Daemon Weapon
rules.text: In the Fight phase, when this model is chosen to fight with for the first time that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, the model suffers 1 mortal wound and cannot use this weapon further that phase. On a 2+ the model can fight with the weapon as normal.

profiles.name: G'holl'ax, Fist of Decay
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll, and an unmodified wound roll of 2+ is always successful.

rules.name: Daemon Weapon
rules.text: In the Fight phase, when this model is chosen to fight with for the first time that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, the model suffers 1 mortal wound and cannot use this weapon further that phase. On a 2+ the model can fight with the weapon as normal.

profiles.name: Ul'o'cca, the Black Axe
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any other damage.

rules.name: Daemon Weapon
rules.text: In the Fight phase, when this model is chosen to fight with for the first time that phase, roll one D6. On a 1, the model suffers 1 mortal wound and cannot use this weapon further that phase. On a 2+ the model can fight with the weapon as normal.

profiles.name: Crown of the Blasphemer
chars: Improve the invulnerable save of a model with this Relic by 1, to a maximum of 3+. Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of models in enemy units whilst their unit is within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: Baleful Icon
chars: When a charge roll is made for a charge declared against any friendly WORD BEARERS units within 6" of a model with this Relic, subtract 2 from the result.

profiles.name: Book of the Reviler
chars: Model that is not a DAEMON only. Before the battle, a model with this Relic can read from the Book of the Reviler. If it does, randomly generate two Chaos Boons for that model from the table found in the Chaos Boon Stratagem (see Codex: Chaos Space Marines), re-rolling Spawndom and Daemonhood and duplicate results. Note that doing so does not cost any Command Points, and an enemy CHARACTER, VEHICLE or MONSTER model does not have to have been destroyed.

profiles.name: The Malefic Tome
chars: PSYKER model only. A model with this Relic knows one additional psychic power from their chosen discipline. When a Psychic test is taken for a model with this Relic, add 1 to the total.

profiles.name: Epistle of Lorgar
chars:
When a model with this Relic chants a prayer, you can re-roll the dice to determine if that prayer is heard. Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of models in friendly WORD BEARERS
units whilst their unit is within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: The Ashen Axe
chars: Enemy units within 1" of a model with this Relic cannot Fall Back unless they have the VEHICLE or TITANIC keyword, or have a minimum Move characteristic.

profiles.name: Stormbolt Plate
chars: INFANTRY model only. A model with this Relic has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, a model with this Relic always counts as being in cover, even while it is not entirely on or within a terrain feature.

profiles.name: Vox Daemonicus
chars: INFANTRY model only. Whilst an enemy unit is within 6" of a model with this Relic, reduce the range of that unit’s aura abilities to 1". In addition, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" of a model with this Relic.

profiles.name: Scourging Chains
chars: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons a model with this Relic is equipped with by 1 (e.g. AP 0 becomes AP -1). Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic (to a minimum of 1) of enemy models whilst they are within 1" of a model with this Relic.

profiles.name: Misery of the Meek
chars: Once per battle, at the start of your Movement phase, a model with this Relic can drink from the Misery of Meek. That model immediately regains up to D6 lost wounds, and until the start of your next turn, add D3 to that model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Talons of the Night Terror
chars: When a model with this Relic fights, it makes D3 additional attacks with this weapon, or D6 additional attacks with this weapon if it made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn.

profiles.name: Flayer
chars: Each model destroyed by an attack with this weapon counts as two for the purposes of Morale tests.

profiles.name: Drakescale Plate
chars: INFANTRY model only. A model with this Relic has a Save characteristic of 2+. When a model with this Relic would lose a wound as a result of a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: Mindveil
chars: At the start of your Movement phase, if a model with this Relic is on the battlefield, roll 3D6; until the end of that phase, that model’s Move characteristic is equal to the result. In the Movement phase, a model with this Relic can move across other models and terrain as if they were not there. In the Charge phase, a model with this Relic can move across other models (other than BUILDINGS) as if they were not there. A model with this Relic can charge in a turn in which they Fall Back.

profiles.name: Hydra's Wail
chars: Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, if a model with this Relic is on the battlefield it can activate the Hydra’s Wail. Until the end of the battle round, when your opponent spends Command Points to use a Stratagem, roll one D6; on a 4+ your opponent must spend one extra Command Point to use that Stratagem, or else it has no effect and the Command Points spent so far are lost.

profiles.name: Hydra's Teeth
chars: Model with a bolt weapon (see page 58) only. The bolt weapons of a model with this Relic are granted the following abilities: Attacks made with this weapon automatically hit the target. This weapon wounds on a 2+ unless it is targeting a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit, in which case it wounds on a 6+. Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.

profiles.name: Shadeblade
chars: When resolving an attack made against the bearer, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Cranium Malevolus
chars: In your Shooting phase, a model with this Relic can use the Cranium Malevolus instead of shooting. Roll one D6 for each enemy VEHICLE unit within 9" of that model; on a 4-5 that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, and on a 6 that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Insidium
chars: A model with this Relic gains the DAEMON keyword (if it does not already have it). Add 1 to the Strength, Toughness and Wounds characteristics of that model.

profiles.name: Techno-venomous Mechatendrils
chars: When the bearer fights, it makes 4 additional attacks with this weapon, and only those 4 attacks can be made with this weapon. When resolving an attack made with this weapon, if a hit is scored the target suffers 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

profiles.name: Siegebreaker Mace
chars: Models with a power maul or accursed crozius only. This Relic replaces the bearer's power maul or accursed crozius.

profiles.name: Siegebreaker Mace - Smash
chars: When the bearer fights using the smash profile, it can only make two attacks. When resolving an attack made with the smash profile, roll two D6 when inflicting damage with it and discard one of the results.

profiles.name: Axe of the Forgemaster
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: Armour of Abhorrence
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at a model with this Relic. If an enemy unit fails a Morale test whilst it is within 6" of a model with this Relic, one additional model flees from that unit.

profiles.name: Remnant of the Maraviglia
chars: PRIEST model only. Once per battle, instead of chanting a prayer, a model with this Relic can broadcast the Remnant of the Maraviglia. Until the end of that battle round, when resolving an attack made by a model in a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit within 6" of a model with this Relic, you can re-roll the wound roll.

profiles.name: The Endless Grin
chars: When a Morale test is taken for an enemy unit within 6" of a model with this Relic, your opponent must roll one additional D6 and you can choose one of those dice to be discarded. Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of models in enemy units whilst their unit is within 6" of a model with this Relic.

profiles.name: Fatal Sonancy
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, do not make a hit roll: it automatically scores a hit. When resolving an attack made with this weapon, the target does not receive the benefit of cover to its saving throw.

profiles.name: Distortion
chars: At the start of the Fight Phase, the bearer can look upon their reflection. Until the end of that phase, this weapon has a Strength characteristic of x2, and when resolving an attack made with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Banner of Rage
chars: PRIEST model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, a model with this Relic can unfurl the Banner of Rage. If they do, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in friendly WORLD EATERS units whilst their unit is within 6" of that model.

profiles.name: Helm of Furore
chars: INFANTRY model only. Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of a model with this Relic. At the start of your Charge phase, if a model with this Relic is within 8" of any enemy units, it must declare a charge.

profiles.name: Bloodhunger
chars: When an enemy model is destroyed in the Fight phase as a result of an attack made by a model with this Relic, roll one D6; on a 4+ the model with this Relic regains up to 1 lost wound.

profiles.name: Crimson Killer
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: Gorefather
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll, and on an unmodified wound roll of 6 the target suffers 3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

profiles.name: Berserker Glaive
chars: When the bearer would lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: Eternal Vendetta
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by your Warlord in the Fight phase against targets with the ADEPTUS ASTARTES keyword.

profiles.name: Flames of Spite
chars: If the wound roll for a melee weapon attack made by your Warlord is 6+, it inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any other damage.

profiles.name: Unholy Fortitude
chars: Add 1 to the Wounds characteristic of your Warlord. In addition, roll a dice each time yourWarlord loses a wound. On a roll of 6, your warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Hatred Incarnate
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Warlord.

profiles.name: Lord of Terror
chars: The opposing player must roll an extra dice when taking Morale tests for units within 6" of your Warlord, and use the highest result.

profiles.name: Exalted Champion
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Master of Timing
chars: You can re-roll one failed Reserve roll each turn.

profiles.name: Burner of Worlds
chars: When you make Firestorm attacks, add 1 to the total number you can make.

profiles.name: Planetary Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Lord of Ambush
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord if targeting an Attacking unit that arrived as reinforcements this turn.

profiles.name: Planetary Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Counterfire Master
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord (this includes any BUILDING they are embarked within, and any other units embarked within the same building).

profiles.name: Fortress Commander
chars: If your Warlord is embarked within a BUILDING, roll a dice each time that building loses a wound; on a 6+, the building does not lose a wound.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: Siege Breaker
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they declare a charge against a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Fortress Destroyer
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they target a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: 1. Cityfight Specialist
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, you receive 3 additional Command Points. These can only be spent to use Cities of Death Stratagems (pg 32-35).

profiles.name: 2. Conqueror of Worlds
chars: If this Warlord is within range of an objective marker (see above) it controls that objective marker even if there are more enemy models within range of the same objective marker. If an enemy unit within range of the same objective marker has a similar ability, then the objective marker is controlled by the player who has the most models within range of it as normal.

profiles.name: 3. Urban Warrior
chars: This Warlord treats all soft cover it is entirely on or within, or that it is receiving the benefit of cover from, as hard cover (pg 30). In addition, enemy units do not receive the benefit to their saving throws for being in cover against attacks made by this Warlord.

profiles.name: First Among Traitors
chars: The Death to the False Emperor ability triggers an extra attack on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+ for models in friendly BLACK LEGION units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Shattering Truth
chars: At the start of each Fight phase, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of your Warlord. That unit cannot be picked to fight with in the Fight phase until all other units able to fight have done so. If the target unit has an ability that allows it to fight first in the Fight phase, it insteads fights as if it didn't have that ability. If both players have units that cannot fight until all other units have done so, then alternate picking which of those units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Carve the Runes
chars: Each time your Warlord slays an enemy CHARACTER, add 2 to your Warlord's Strength and Attacks characteristics until the end of the battle.

profiles.name: Maelstrom of Torment
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy untis within 6" of your Warlord. If your Warlord has slain any enemy models, then until the end of the battle, subtract 2 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy models within 9" of your Warlord instead.

profiles.name: Blessed Mission
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Warlord. In addition, you can re-roll damage rolls for weapons used by your Warlord.

profiles.name: Ultimate Confidence
chars: If your Warlord generates extra attacks as a result of their Death to the Imperfect trait, they can immediately make 3 additional attacks, instead of only 1, against the same unit using the same weapon. These extra attacks cannot themselves generate any further attacks.

profiles.name: Reaver Lord
chars: Your army can have one extra relic, chosen from the Artefacts of Chaos, which must be given to a RED CORSAIRS CHARACTER from your army that does not already have a relic. This relic must be different to any relics already included in your army. In addition, each time your Warlord slays an enemy CHARACTER, add 1 to your Warlord's Attack characteristic until the end of the battle.

profiles.name: Arch-Sorceror
chars: Your Warlord knows 1 additional psychic power from any of the disciplines listed on their datasheet.

profiles.name: Devourer of Magic
chars: Your Warlord can attempt to deny one additional power in each enemy Psychic phase. In addition, your Warlord regains 1 lost wound each time it successfully denies a psychic power.

profiles.name: Reader of Fate
chars: Once per battle, you can re-roll a failed Psychic test or Deny the Witch test for your Warlord. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged, roll a D6 each time your Warlord successfully manifests a psychic power; on a 6 you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: Infernal Gaze
chars: If your Warlord successfully manifests the Smite psychic power, the closest visible enemy unit within 24" suffers mortal wounds, instead of 18".

profiles.name: Warp Lord
chars: You can re-roll rolls of 1 when taking a Psychic test for your Warlord.

profiles.name: Daemon-bound Power
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord's Strength characteristic. In addition, you can re-roll damage rolls made for attacks with your Warlord's force weapon. For the purposes of this Warlord Trait, a force weapon is any weapon whose name includes the word 'force' (excluding Artefacts of Chaos).

profiles.name: Shepherd of the True Faith
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack made with a melee weapon by a friendly DAEMONKIN RITUALIST unit within 6" of your Warlord, that attack inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to the normal damage.

profiles.name: Chosen of the Warmaster
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units while they are witihn 6" of your Warlord. If your Warlord has the Lord of Chaos ability, you can instead re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly BRINGERS OF DESPAIR units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Armour Bane
chars: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEVASTATION BATTERY units that are within 6" of your Warlord if the target is a VEHICLE.

profiles.name: The Tip of the Claw
chars: Add 2 to charge rolls made for friendly HOST RAPTORIAL units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Master of the Soulforges
chars: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly SOULFORGED PACK DAEMON ENGINES while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Exultant Preacher
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly CULT OF THE DAMNED units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Veteran Raider
chars: While they are within 6" of your Warlord, friendly BLACK LEGION units can declare a charge even if they Fell Back in the same turn.

profiles.name: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by your Warlord is halved, rounding up.

profiles.name: Black-clad Brute
chars: Add 1 to your Warlord’s Strength characteristic. In addition, after your Warlord makes a charge move, pick an enemy unit within 1" of your Warlord and roll a D6. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Soul-eater
chars: Each time your Warlord destroys an enemy unit, your Warlord immediately regains D3 lost wounds.

profiles.name: Trusted War-leader
chars: While your Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a D6 each time you spend a Command Point to use a Stratagem; on a 5+ that Command Point is immediately refunded.

profiles.name: First Among Traitors
chars: The Death to the False Emperor ability triggers an extra attack on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+ for models in friendly BLACK LEGION units while they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: The Voice of Lorgar
chars: Add 3" to the range of this Warlord’s aura abilities (e.g. Lord of Chaos).

profiles.name: Exalted Possession
chars: This Warlord gains the POSSESSED and DAEMON keywords (if they don’t already have them). Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of this Warlord, and add 1" to this Warlord’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: Daemonic Whispers
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, roll one D3 before the battle begins; you gain a number of additional Command Points equal to the result. Once per battle, if this Warlord is on the battlefield, you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: Master of the Union
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in friendly WORD BEARERS DAEMON units whilst their unit is within 6" of this Warlord.

profiles.name: Diabolist
chars: When this Warlord would lose a wound, roll one D6, adding 3 to the result if that wound would be lost as the result of a mortal wound; on a 6+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: Sacrilegious Regeneration
